defect: The check that a keyed member is non-public is inverted (== Public instead of != Public), so a keyed non-public member no longer marks non-public members as serialized.
why: Serialized private members then escape the rule that every non-public member must carry an explicit [Key] or [IgnoreMember], so private state can be serialized without the author deciding it.
